grid=[[9]*20 for _ in range(29)]
for r in range(29):
 for c in range(20):
  if r in (9,19) or c in (6,13): grid[r][c]=2
seed=[[1,5,9,9,9,9],[6,4,9,9,5,9],[9,9,6,9,9,9],[9,1,9,4,9,9],[9,9,9,6,9,9],[5,4,9,4,1,9],[9,5,4,1,4,5],[1,9,9,6,9,9],[9,9,9,9,6,9]]
# check against exact visible rows
for pr in range(3):
 for pc in range(2):
  for i in range(9):
   for j in range(6): grid[pr*10+i][pc*7+j]=seed[i][j]
def transform(g):
 h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
 # seed is bottom-left 9x6; repeat panels separated by color 2
 rr=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if all(x==2 for x in row)]
 cc=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(h))]
 rh=[rr[0]+1 if rr else h]; cw=[cc[0]+1 if cc else w]
 tile=[g[rh[0]+i][:cw[0]-1] for i in range(h-rh[0])]
 # determine actual region bounds based on separator lines
 rstarts=[0]+[x+1 for x in rr]; cstarts=[0]+[x+1 for x in cc]
 for ri,rs in enumerate(rstarts):
  re=rr[ri] if ri<len(rr) else h
  for ci,cs in enumerate(cstarts):
   ce=cc[ci] if ci<len(cc) else w
   for i in range(re-rs):
    for j in range(ce-cs): out[rs+i][cs+j]=tile[i][j]
 return out
# store program
